channel.title: The Argo: the house of yoss.eth
channel.description: What happened to the Argonauts and Leaves of one house.

item.title: Neophon #141 was broken in the archipelago (lost on the voyage to the Isles of the Blest).
item.description: Neophon #141 was broken in the archipelago (lost on the voyage to the Isles of the Blest). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.
